facts.fact: The Strategic Plan approved by Presidential Decree 267/24 states that civil registration is at present done by five coexisting means, ordinary books, 'smart books', the Sistema Integrado de Registo Civil, the system integrated with identity card data and the PROMOREM application, and calls the method of civil registration antiquated.

The Strategic Plan approved by Presidential Decree 267/24 states that the civil registry services number more than 300 and have no centralised database system; it gives no count of services registering in any of the digital systems it lists.

Presidential Decree 267/24 approved the Strategic Plan for the Universalisation of the Identity Card, to run from January 2025 to December 2026, which provides for a single database (Base de Dados Única) fed daily by a new method of civil registration from a cut-off date, integration of the identity card, civil registry and adult-citizen databases, and intercommunication between conservatórias and identification posts.

The Strategic Plan approved by Presidential Decree 267/24 places the single database and the civil registry and identification services that are to feed it with the Ministry of Justice and Human Rights, monitored by the Interministerial Commission created by Presidential Order 231/22.
